newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Tuesday:

In answer to a question, spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said the Commission would not decide on MEP Jose Happart's removal from the inquiry committee on BSE because of his statements this weekend but would suggest the European Parliament take the necessary decision itself.
Van der Pas also said the Commission's suggestion was based in particular on Article 4 of the interinstitutional regulation prohibiting public nominative accusations of European officials.

Asked about the Commission's reaction to the Maltese national elections that brought the labour party to power, van der Pas said no direct contact had been made so far on the consequences for the pre-accession negotiations to the EU.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/96/963: Financial aid for 11 trans-European telecommunications networks: applications.
- Main items on the agenda of the Commission's weekly meeting of 30 October 1996.
